MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Wire connectors and super glue fit my habit of keeping practical supplies for joining parts and making repairs, alongside my rivets, screws, and mounting tape.",
    "Pegboard storage feels useful as my collection of tools and fasteners grows, while removable gaffers tape offers temporary positioning that complements my strong adhesives."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Concrete filler and window or bathroom caulk require specific sealing jobs that my recent purchases do not suggest I am doing.",
    "Calibration weights and multimeter leads serve particular equipment needs; owning a caliper and inspection camera does not mean I own a small scale or compatible multimeter.",
    "Food containers have no clear connection to the repair and fabrication tasks behind my recent purchases."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in adhesives seems to have been extended too broadly to sealants, even though attaching parts and sealing building joints serve different purposes.",
    "My interest in workshop tools seems to have been taken as interest in any measuring or repair accessory, regardless of whether I have the equipment or task it requires."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated purchases of rivets, threaded inserts, bolts, drill bits, and cutting wheels point toward assembling and modifying materials, which makes practical joining supplies especially relevant.",
    "Accessories are more compelling when they work with tools I have shown an interest in; specialized equipment requirements make an otherwise related item less useful.",
    "The growing assortment of tools and small hardware makes organization and versatile project supplies appealing without needing to assume a specific new repair job."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my hands-on workshop interests but stretched them too far into specialized equipment accessories and household sealing jobs."
}
